findings: For Lactoferrin

The company reports the development and commercialization of its NutriPRO Lactoferrin ingredients following a multi-million dollar capital improvement project at its Fond Du Lac, Wisconsin facility to concentrate whey protein fractions into standard and high-purity (up to 95% purity) grades.

In a peer-reviewed study published in the Journal of Dairy Research, researchers utilized commercially prepared lactoferrin supplied by Actus Nutrition (doing business as Milk Specialties Global) to evaluate the clinical impacts of lactoferrin supplementation in milk replacers on pre- and post-weaning dairy calf growth and feed efficiency.
The rating rests on the company’s established production capabilities for purified bovine lactoferrin and the inclusion of its ingredients in independent animal nutrition studies.
